pages.title: Maxematics: One-on-One Tutoring in Tampa, FL
pages.description: Max Schwarzkopf tutors math, science, language and test prep in Tampa and over video. Every program is written for one student.

props.headline: Tutoring built around one student at a time.

features.title: Every program tailored to the student
features.description: Sessions start from where the student actually is, and the plan changes as they do.

features.title: Custom worksheets & practice exams
features.description: Practice material is written for the topic at hand, rather than pulled from a generic packet.

features.title: Virtual, or in a Tampa learning space
features.description: Meet online from anywhere, or in person at a quiet space in Tampa.

features.title: Study & time management skills
features.description: Alongside the subject itself, students work on how to plan, revise and sit an exam.

features.title: Summer refreshers & final exam prep
features.description: Focused runs before finals, and lighter sessions over the summer to keep the material warm.

features.title: SAT, ACT & Desmos support
features.description: Section strategy, timing, and the Desmos calculator practised until it stops costing time.

props.heading: The Tutor Behind Maxematics
props.founderRole: Founder & tutor; STEM student and researcher
props.pullQuote: If you think of something as ‘hard,’ it will be. But it doesn’t have to be that way.

props.subheading: Math and science sit alongside language, writing and history. Test preparation runs through all of it.

services.title: Algebra 1 & 2
services.description: Equations, functions and graphing, worked until the steps stop feeling like guesswork.

services.title: Precalculus
services.description: Trigonometry, sequences and the groundwork that Calculus takes for granted.

services.title: Calculus 1 & 2
services.description: Limits, derivatives and integrals, with time spent on why each one is the right tool.

services.title: Geometry
services.description: Proofs, angles and coordinate work, built up from the definitions.

services.title: Statistics
services.description: Distributions, inference, and reading a result without over-claiming it.

services.title: SAT/ACT/Desmos
services.description: Section strategy, pacing, and using the Desmos calculator well under time pressure.

services.title: Chemistry
services.description: Stoichiometry, bonding and reactions, one mechanism at a time.

services.title: Biology
services.description: Systems, genetics and the vocabulary, organised so it holds through an exam.

services.title: Physics
services.description: Mechanics, energy and waves, starting from the diagram rather than the formula.

services.title: Latin 1 & 2
services.description: Declensions, syntax and translation practice at a steady, repeatable pace.

services.title: Creative & Technical Writing
services.description: Structure first, then sentences. Essays, lab reports and personal statements all get the same treatment.

props.heading: Straightforward Session Pricing
props.subheading: Every session is one to one, and priced by its length.

items.question: Are sessions virtual or in person?
items.answer: Either. Sessions run online from anywhere, or in person at a learning space in Tampa, FL.

items.question: How is payment handled?
items.answer: Zelle, check and cash are all accepted. Payment is arranged directly with Max.

items.question: How does a student get started?
items.answer: Send a note through the form below or by email. A line or two about the student, the subject and the goal is enough to begin with.

props.heading: Ready to talk about a plan for your student?
props.subheading: Say a little about the subject and where things are getting stuck, and Max will take it from there.

props.heading: Send Max a Note
props.subheading: Tutoring enquiries, scheduling and questions about rates all reach the same inbox. A little detail about the student and the goal helps make the first reply a useful one.
